llgl.reason: Native Vulkan physical-device/queue handles and explicit command/fence/resource APIs map to all four contracts. Existing CMP-02..10 roadmap selects LLGL.
llgl.workload_caveat: Vulkan is experimental/opt-in. Required layers may be ignored if absent; verify actual load. GPU-assisted validation defaults ON; force OFF. Default internal suballocation is not native-allocation equivalence.

sdl.reason: Existing baseline comparator; current Vulkan CPU contracts and separate validation protocol retained.
sdl.workload_caveat: Public GPU timestamp gap remains required P3-BEN-09; native-handle attribution is not independently verified. Preserve existing per-profile API-version/layout/usage differences.

diligent_core.reason: Real Vulkan Win32/Linux build branch and device/resource/PSO APIs confirmed. Additional comparison deferred to conditional CMP-11, not excluded.
diligent_core.workload_caveat: Independently pinned Core implementation, not a claim that Engine parent submodule matches this Core pin. Need explicit transfer/fence/shader lifecycle and Vulkan dependency audit.

bgfx.reason: Real Vulkan backend and Windows/Linux configuration confirmed. Additional comparison deferred to conditional CMP-12, not excluded.
bgfx.workload_caveat: Pinned public read(TextureRegion, data) completes at a future frame. Frame/render-thread scheduling and shader/program versus native-PSO semantics need a dedicated equivalence adapter.

the_forge.reason: Actual Vulkan.c backend and Windows/Linux config confirmed. Additional comparison deferred to conditional CMP-13, not excluded.
the_forge.workload_caveat: RHI queue/fence/draw APIs exist; ResourceLoader/shader construction and vendor branches require explicit timing boundaries and a fresh Vulkan input audit. Vulkan.c references NOTICE, but no project-root NOTICE exists at this pin; resolve applicable notices before redistribution.

nvrhi.reason: Pinned README declares Vulkan 1.3 on Windows/Linux; full Vulkan backend/build not reviewed here. Retain as a follow-up candidate, no new acceptance task selected.
nvrhi.workload_caveat: Higher declared API floor than current Vulkan 1.1 baseline; caller-native device integration and hidden upload/lifetime policies require separate workload and dependency review.

dawn.reason: Pinned README declares native Vulkan WebGPU backend; full platform/backend build not reviewed here. Retain as a follow-up candidate, no new acceptance task selected.
dawn.workload_caveat: WebGPU device/shader validation and asynchronous completion require a separate adapter review. No conclusion about SPIR-V/native extension or timestamp equivalence from README alone.

sandbox.reason: Pinned complete tree and cached Vulkan implementation blob confirmed. Retain as a follow-up candidate; not classified as lacking Vulkan.
sandbox.workload_caveat: No project-root LICENSE/COPYING in pinned complete tree. Dependency licenses do not grant project-wide redistribution rights; permission and complete workload/build review required before integration.
